choose.when: SELECT member_id as memberId, amount, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM daily_balance WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY created_at

SELECT member_id as memberId, SUM(amount) as amount, DATE(DATE_SUB(MIN(created_at), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(MIN(created_at)) DAY)) as createdAt, MAX(updated_at) as updatedAt FROM daily_balance WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 WEEK) GROUP BY member_id, YEAR(created_at), WEEK(created_at, 1) ORDER BY createdAt

SELECT member_id as memberId, SUM(amount) as amount, CONCAT(YEAR(MIN(created_at)), '-', LPAD(MONTH(MIN(created_at)), 2, '0'), '-01') as createdAt, MAX(updated_at) as updatedAt FROM daily_balance WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) GROUP BY member_id, YEAR(created_at), MONTH(created_at) ORDER BY createdAt
